style: cinematic 3D Pixar slapstick deadpan; tactile look, dirt/dust in skin and fabric, no glossy sheen, matte textures, hard sunlit daylight
shot: pit-level angle; camera moves only: push-in on mole 3.1-3.45; whip revealing pit walls 5.8-6.4; continuous push-in on her face 7.0-9.9, no cut; other beats static
character: PIG: plump pink pig builder, heavy-lidded eyes, dirty apron, doomed cheerful optimism, same design as prior clips; trotters lean, press, toss, plant, scrawl, snort, slump
cast: MOLE: agent mole, striped tie, folder under arm, active every beat, never speaks
props: SHOVEL: one shovel, reused every action. FOLDER: mole's folder open to signature line. LADDER: already leaning on the pit's inner wall before mole reaches it, never floating.
setting: freshly dug foundation pit, construction site, dark soil at rim, ladder on wall, small burrow for mole nearby, no walls built yet
lighting: hard bright midday sun, full daylight, no shade; crisp hard shadows; sun reaches pit floor, floor as bright as rim at every depth

audio.delivery: male low warm chest voice ~130Hz, dry unrushed flat deadpan, @Voice: Sadachbia
audio.pacing: «Рыла яму»: RY-la YA-mu, 4 syll/0.9s. «под фундамент»: pod fun-DA-ment, stress DA, 4 syll/0.9s, no pause after 'яму'. «А выкопала»: a VY-ko-pa-la, stress VY, 5 syll/1.1s. «долговую яму»: dol-go-VU-yu YA-mu, stress VU+YA, 6 syll/1.2s, upper edge, unrushed, don't rush the prior beat. Nothing after 9.9.
audio.lip_sync: mouth opens/closes clearly each syllable, her own voice, never voice-over
sfx: mole bursting up with spray and shake-off

timeline.a: silent. HOOK: lean slams shovel into ground; dirt flies. Shovel #1.
silent. Tosses dirt over shoulder; trotters spin/slip. Shovel #2.
calm, mouth clear each syllable, same rhythm, still pressing the shovel, no new action.
calm, no pause, same press and sway, no new gesture.
silent. Mole bursts up in a fountain of dirt, shakes off.
silent. Mole jabs a claw at the signature line.
silent. Plants shovel as a stand, frees a hoof, scrawls signature blind. Shovel #3.
silent. Mole stamp-slaps the paper once.
silent. Mole grabs the ladder on the wall.
silent. Mole dives with the ladder into the burrow, tail flashing; dirt crumbles on her snout.
silent. ANTI-ACTION: she snorts dirt off her snout, same opening tic, now pointless — walls already higher than her shoulders. Pit never changes size, only the reveal does.
silent. Reaches for the shovel at the rim, slips, slides back down. Shovel #4, missed.
silent. Sinks onto haunches, hooves buckling, gaze lifting.
keeps sinking onto haunches, snout trembling, gaze on the sky.
settling deeper, dust off her shoulders, tail sagging, unrushed.
silent. Rests in final pose; at frame top the shovel sways, out of reach. Shovel #5, final.

must_appear: single shovel for all five actions; mole bursts up, shakes off, jabs signature line; her blind signature; the stamp slap; ladder leaning before mole grabs and dives in, tail flashing; pit depth shown only by camera reveal, not size change; she keeps sinking through both final lines, dust and tail moving; final shot holds her face and the shovel in focus
negative_prompt: night, dusk, lamp, dim, moody, dark, underexposed, low-key, pit darker than rim; floating or unsupported props, airborne ladder or shovel; duplicate shovel, second shovel, duplicate ladder, second ladder, stacked props; morphing pit, hole changing size instead of camera reveal; second pig, second mole, other animals; extra limbs, human hands; camera movement beyond described; cuts, jump cuts; costume change mid-shot; rushed or slow speech, drawn-out delivery, foreign accent, English speech, mid-sentence pauses; subtitles, captions, watermark, text overlay, readable text
